tinea_corporis.description: Tinea corporis is a superficial fungal infection of the skin caused by dermatophytes, producing circular, annular, erythematous scaly plaques with raised borders.
tinea_corporis.clinical_presentation: Red, circular patch with active scaly or vesicular borders and characteristic central clearing. Commonly pruritic (itchy).
common_symptoms: May spread to nearby areas or close contacts
guideline_recommendations: Keep the affected area clean and thoroughly dry.
Use topical antifungal cream (e.g., clotrimazole, terbinafine) as advised by a doctor.
Avoid sharing personal towels, bedding, or clothing.
Consult a doctor or dermatologist for a proper prescription if it spreads or fails to resolve.
tinea_corporis.patient_friendly_summary_en: Tinea corporis is a common fungal skin infection (ringworm). It forms a red, circular patch with a scaly border and is typically treated effectively with topical antifungal creams.
tinea_corporis.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह टीनिया कॉर्पोरिस (दाद/रिंगवर्म) है, जो फंगल इन्फेक्शन के कारण होता है। इसमें त्वचा पर लाल, गोल और खुजलीदार चकत्ते बनते हैं जो एंटीफंगल क्रीम से ठीक हो जाते हैं।

eczema.description: A chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by dry, pruritic, and erythematous patches often in skin flexures.
eczema.clinical_presentation: Ill-defined erythematous patches, excoriations, lichenification, and intense pruritus.
guideline_recommendations: Frequent liberal application of fragrance-free emollients/moisturizers.
Short, lukewarm showers using soap-free cleansers.
Topical corticosteroids or calcineurin inhibitors as prescribed by a physician.
Avoid known contact allergens and scratch trauma.

citations.title: Guidelines for the management of atopic eczema

eczema.patient_friendly_summary_en: Atopic dermatitis (eczema) is an itchy, inflammatory skin condition manageable with regular moisturizing and gentle skin care.
eczema.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह एक्जिमा (Atopic Dermatitis) है जिसमें त्वचा पर सूखापन, लाली और तेज खुजली होती है। मॉइस्चराइजर और डॉक्टर की सलाह से यह नियंत्रित रहता है।

psoriasis.description: An immune-mediated chronic inflammatory skin disease characterized by sharply demarcated erythematous plaques with thick silvery-white scales.
psoriasis.clinical_presentation: Well-demarcated salmon-pink plaques with overlying silvery mica-like scales, commonly on extensor surfaces (elbows, knees, scalp).
common_symptoms: Dry, cracked skin that may bleed
guideline_recommendations: Regular application of keratolytics and rich emollients.
Topical vitamin D analogues and potent topical corticosteroids under clinical guidance.
Systemic or biologic therapies for moderate-to-severe disease.
Avoid skin trauma (Koebner phenomenon).

citations.title: Joint AAD-NPF guidelines of care for the management of psoriasis

psoriasis.patient_friendly_summary_en: Psoriasis is a chronic condition causing red plaques covered with silvery scales. It is not contagious and responds well to targeted medical treatment.
psoriasis.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह सोरायसिस है, जो त्वचा की कोशिकाओं के तेजी से बनने के कारण मोटी चांदी जैसी पपड़ी बनाता है। यह छूने से नहीं फैलता।

acne.urgency: Routine primary or cosmetic dermatology care
acne.description: A chronic inflammatory disorder of the pilosebaceous unit presenting with comedones, papules, pustules, nodules, and potential scarring.
acne.clinical_presentation: Open and closed comedones, inflamed red papules, pustules, and sebaceous oiliness on the face, chest, or back.
guideline_recommendations: Gentle twice-daily cleansing with a non-comedogenic foaming cleanser.
Topical retinoids, benzoyl peroxide, or topical antibiotics.
Avoid squeezing or picking lesions to minimize hyperpigmentation and scarring.
Daily broad-spectrum non-comedogenic sunscreen.

citations.title: Guidelines of care for the management of acne vulgaris

acne.patient_friendly_summary_en: Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition involving blocked oil glands and pores. Good skincare and doctor-prescribed topicals keep it under control.
acne.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह मुंहासे (Acne) हैं जो त्वचा के रोमछिद्रों में तेल और बैक्टीरिया जमा होने से होते हैं। सही फेस वॉश और दवा से यह साफ हो जाते हैं।

mel.urgency: Urgent Dermatologist Review (2-week wait / Immediate Referral)
mel.description: A high-risk skin cancer arising from melanocytes, requiring immediate clinical evaluation, dermoscopic biopsy, and surgical excision.
mel.clinical_presentation: Asymmetric pigmented lesion with irregular borders, color variegation (black, brown, blue, red), diameter >6mm, and dynamic evolution.
guideline_recommendations: Immediate full-thickness excisional biopsy with histological margin evaluation.
Avoid shave or partial biopsy.
Prompt referral to a dermatologic oncologist or specialist surgeon.

citations.title: International Skin Imaging Collaboration Melanoma Benchmark

mel.patient_friendly_summary_en: This lesion displays characteristics that require prompt, urgent evaluation by a dermatologist to ensure patient safety.
mel.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह मेलेनोमा के लक्षणों से मेल खाता है। कृपया तुरंत किसी त्वचा विशेषज्ञ से व्यक्तिगत जांच करवाएं।

bcc.description: The most common non-melanoma skin cancer originating from epidermal basal cells. Locally invasive but rarely metastasizes.
bcc.clinical_presentation: Pearly or translucent papule with telangiectasia, rolled border, central depression or ulceration.
guideline_recommendations: Histological confirmation via punch or shave biopsy.
Surgical excision or Mohs micrographic surgery for high-risk facial zones.
Routine sun protection.
bcc.patient_friendly_summary_en: Basal cell carcinoma is a slow-growing skin cancer that should be checked and treated by a dermatologist to prevent local growth.
bcc.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह बेसल सेल कार्सिनोमा है, जो धीरे-धीरे बढ़ता है और डॉक्टर द्वारा छोटी सी सर्जरी से पूरी तरह ठीक हो जाता है।

nv.description: A completely benign proliferation of melanocytes commonly known as a mole. Harmless in the overwhelming majority of cases.
nv.clinical_presentation: Symmetric, uniformly pigmented tan or brown macule or papule with smooth, regular borders.
guideline_recommendations: Routine periodic self-checks using ABCDE rules.
No surgical treatment necessary unless symptomatic, changing, or irritated.
Apply daily broad-spectrum sun protection.

citations.title: Classification of Skin Tumours: Melanocytic Lesions

nv.patient_friendly_summary_en: This is a benign, common mole (melanocytic nevus). Routine self-checks are recommended, with no urgent action required.
nv.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह एक सामान्य और हानिरहित तिल (Nevus) है। इसमें चिंता की कोई बात नहीं है।

bkl.description: A benign skin growth including seborrheic keratoses and solar lentigines, appearing waxy and 'stuck-on'.
bkl.clinical_presentation: Well-demarcated tan, brown, or black plaque with a greasy or verrucous surface.
guideline_recommendations: Reassurance; no treatment required unless irritated by clothing or friction.
bkl.patient_friendly_summary_en: This is a harmless, non-cancerous benign keratosis. It does not spread and requires no treatment unless bothersome.
bkl.patient_friendly_summary_hi: यह एक हानिरहित मस्सा या तिल जैसा उभार (Benign Keratosis) है, जो बिल्कुल सुरक्षित होता है।

triage_red_flags: Rapid ulceration, oozing, or persistent bleeding without trauma
Spreading erythema (redness), swelling, or severe tenderness
Fever, chills, night sweats, or swollen regional lymph nodes
Lesion evolving visibly in shape, color, or size within weeks
Severe systemic itching, numbness, or shooting pain
